newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti share trading halts for 6th time.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti share trading halts for 6th time.

text.p: Trading in shares in Italian crisis-ridden information technology group Olivetti came to a halt for the sixth time on Tuesday, this time braking at 466 lire per share.
A further attempt to trade the stock will be made at 1400 GMT.

Olivetti has kangarooed through the day's trade, tripping the automatic suspension as brokers sold on concern over the company's financial health. But stock market authorities have not widened the 10 percent fluctuation limit as they did last week when the troubled stock kept being driven limit down.

The stock market is waiting to see what answers Olivetti will supply to 16 questions on the state of its finances posed by bourse regulator Consob. An answer is expected from the group some time after the bourse closes at 1500 GMT.
